item.description: Start extra servers for failure simulation: RIVERREADY_EA_BASE_URL=http://nonexistent.invalid/x php -S localhost:8011 -t backend/public backend/public/index.php ; RIVERREADY_EA_TIMEOUT=1 RIVERREADY_EA_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=1 RIVERREADY_EA_BASE_URL=http://10.255.255.1/x php -S localhost:8012 -t backend/public backend/public/index.php

exec: pm.test('Has items array and fetchedAt', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('fetchedAt'); });

item.name: Stations search - no matches (empty list, still 200)
Stations search - limit not a number (400)

exec: pm.test('Has measures with latest', () => { const s = pm.response.json().station; pm.expect(s.reference).to.eql('4009'); pm.expect(s.measures[0]).to.have.property('latest'); });

pm.test('Has location, actions, external', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.location.id).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.actions).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.external.status).to.be.oneOf(['ok','empty']); });

item.name: FAILURE SIM: stations search, EA host unreachable (502)  [needs server on :8011]
FAILURE SIM: station details, EA host unreachable (502)
FAILURE SIM: overview still 200 when EA unreachable

exec: pm.test('external unavailable, stored data present', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.external.status).to.eql('unavailable'); pm.expect(j.external.data).to.eql(null); pm.expect(j.location.id).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.actions).to.be.an('array'); });

exec: pm.test('external timeout', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.external.status).to.eql('timeout'); pm.expect(j.location.id).to.eql(1); });
